name: Cani
summary: Cani is a term used in Spain to describe a youth subculture that originated in the 1990s, primarily associated with working-class young men in the southern region of Andalusia.
description: Cani is a term used in Spain to describe a youth subculture that originated in the 1990s, primarily associated with working-class young men in the southern region of Andalusia. The aesthetic is defined by a specific style of sportswear, an affinity for gold jewelry, and a "bad boy" persona. The term itself is often considered a pejorative, classist slur used to stereotype and ridicule working-class youth, though it is sometimes used ironically or as a self-identifier. [ 1 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Group identity, brand consciousness, perceived aggression, hypermasculinity

visualDNA.colour: Black, white, gold, often with vibrant colors from football teams

fashion.Overview: The Cani aesthetic is centered on brand-name sportswear and conspicuous accessories, often featuring counterfeit or bootleg items. The "classic" Cani look of the 2000s included tracksuits, muscle shirts, and bootleg football team jerseys. Accessories were central, with a heavy emphasis on gold jewelry such as large chains and rings, as well as piercings in the eyebrow or lip. Baseball caps worn sideways or backward, often from brands like Nike, were also a key element.
